name: fm-national-tax-social-reference
description: Federated States of Micronesia national wage tax, employer withholding, gross revenue tax and social security for a small business and its employees in 2026. Gives the 6% and 10% wage bands, the $1,000 refund deduction, quarterly due dates, the $80 band and 3% rate, section 112 as amended, the 7.5% shares, the $9,000 wage base, penalties, interest and worked figures. Refuses major corporations, state taxes, customs and the Chapter 8 replacement revenue law. No national VAT was found. This source-cited draft awaits local professional review and is not filing readiness.
